blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `beginClaimOrderValidationStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that the order associated with the claim isn't canceled.
If not valid, the step will throw an error.

You can retrieve an order's details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).
